operational_effect.meaning: Record actor/action participation and posture while preserving action immutability, ownership and authority.
operational_effect.record_delta: Append one exact immutable witnessed relation record, or idempotently retain an identical existing revision; same revision with different content is refused.
operational_effect.recording_preservation: Recording a relation preserves authority roots, ownership, identity classes, admissions and runtime/external state. A separately authorized execution can change only its approved domain envelope.
operational_effect.execution_boundary: A record append does not implement its source witness's execution. Materialization requires evidence of a completed authorized atomic application; no standalone relation row proves it.

worked_failure: An action attributed to A in another agent's session is not an exact attribution witness.
source_refinement_contract: Under exact owned catalog/frame well-formedness, decoding and resolution of raw source fields yields a iff the independently specified source constraints denote Meaning_K29(W,a). The decoder/checker must not define that source predicate.
proof_contract: Prove the independent meaning has a valid positive model.
Prove each exact qualifier mapping and checker/meaning equivalence.
Prove declared record effect and any required execution/closure preservation.
Check each kind-scoped non-entailment countermodel under the complete pinned theory.
Account for all declared ordered pairs and prove role-sensitive branches; one positive example per kind is insufficient.
approval_scope_note: The prior receipt, if present, retains its exact earlier scope. It does not accept this expanded batch revision, global policies or proofs.
formal_expression: Meaning_K29(W,e,f) := ∃ w ∈ W.AttributedAction. Base_K29(W,e,f,w) ∧ (w.agent = s ∧ w.operation = t ∧ w.session = resolve(q.session_ref) ∧ w.session.agent = s ∧ w.role = code(q.participation_role) ∧ w.posture = code(q.action_posture) ∧ AttributedOperation(W,w,f))

notation.W: independently supplied typed semantic world, exact captured bodies and owner catalogs; not checker output
notation.e: candidate edge with kind, exact source s, exact target t and closed raw qualifiers q
notation.f: complete exact evaluation frame and selected meaning/evidence/digest/catalog profiles
notation.q: e.qualifiers; precisely the required fields listed below
notation.w: independent normalized primary witness record, with the following typed roles

witness_fields.operation: Action, experiment/research run, Review or Work exact revision
witness_fields.posture: proposed, attempted, completed, rejected or failed constructor
witness_fields.operationEpoch: recorded operation epoch in the session domain

special_atoms.resolve: The unique entry for the raw token in the selected immutable typed reference catalog for this relation, pair, field and frame. Missing, ambiguous or wrong-kind entries are undefined and cannot establish Meaning.
special_atoms.code: The unique entry in the owner-reviewed code catalog indexed by relation kind, exact ordered pair, field and catalog revision. Its semantic constructor and record role must agree; identical spellings in another catalog are distinct.
special_atoms.AttributedOperation: The operation and session records identify this agent, role and posture; admissible operation evidence supplies the operation epoch, and the exact session is active at that epoch in the same time domain. This predicate does not require successful effect or owner approval.

base_definition: Base requires exact selected kind/meaning revision; membership of this ordered pair in the pinned signature; independently captured endpoint revisions; exactly the declared qualifier fields with unique typed catalog interpretation; primary witness source/target joins and frame agreement; and provenance sufficient for the declared claim tier. It never invokes the relation checker. Undefined resolution cannot establish Meaning.

plain_language_intuition.text: An agent is attributable to an operation in its exact active session and recorded posture. An attempted or failed action remains an attempted or failed action.

operational_interpretation.meaning: Record actor/action participation and posture while preserving action immutability, ownership and authority.

operational_interpretation.recording_preservation: Recording a relation preserves authority roots, ownership, identity classes, admissions and runtime/external state. A separately authorized execution can change only its approved domain envelope.
operational_interpretation.execution_boundary: A record append does not implement its source witness's execution. Materialization requires evidence of a completed authorized atomic application; no standalone relation row proves it.
operational_interpretation.record_postcondition: R_after = R_before ∪ {exactRecord(e,w,f)} for a new row; identical retry leaves R unchanged; same record identity with different content refuses atomically.
operational_interpretation.meaning_world_preserved: W_after = W_before; appending the relation log alone does not execute its witness, change authority roots or replace active artifacts.
operational_interpretation.composed_closure_status: Full-rule/composed-state preservation remains a separate theorem target; append-only local behavior does not prove it.
